title: Register `watch` as a built-in pack so the assimilated video skill materializes into .claude/skills/
description:
The `watch` video skill (from github.com/bradautomates/claude-video, plugin `watch` v0.2.0, MIT) was assimilated on 2026-07-23 via hivemind-assimilate-skill: the owned+re-scoped copy is staged at `assimilated-skills/watch/` and `integrations.lock.json` carries `skill:watch` owned by pack `watch@0.2.0` (install_method assimilated, security verdict `safe`, pin 83da59fa78c3eee9e20f515fe75c438bb5166efd). Security review passed (dedicated security-reviewer subagent, verdict `safe`: keys read from ~/.config/watch/.env and sent only to the matching provider endpoint, no exfiltration/injection; only destructive op is rm -rf on the script's own temp dir).

Activation is blocked: `reconcile-apply` only reconciles packs in the hardcoded `BUILTIN_PACK_DESCRIPTORS` list (src/builtin-packs.js), currently `[DESIGN_POWER_DESCRIPTOR]` only. There is no packs/ auto-discovery, so the new `watch@0.2.0` owner edge is invisible to the reconciler and the skill is NOT materialized into `.claude/skills/watch/`.

Deliver: author `packs/watch/descriptor.json` (conforming to the pack-descriptor schema; id `watch`, version `0.2.0`, listing the assimilated `watch` skill resource with origin/pin matching the lock edge) and register the descriptor+module pair at the single accretion point in src/builtin-packs.js (BUILTIN_PACK_DESCRIPTORS + BUILTIN_PACK_MODULES), mirroring how design-power is wired. Then `reconcile-apply` must materialize the owned copy into `.claude/skills/watch/`. Because this touches src/ and requires rebuilding dist/pack-ctl.cjs (dist-parity gate), run `npm run test:all` at the hand-off and reviewer gates, and commit the rebuilt dist/ bundles. Do NOT re-run the assimilation itself (already owned+vetted) and do NOT weaken any assimilate security invariant.

Follow-up: consider whether new built-in packs should be auto-discovered from packs/*/descriptor.json rather than hardcoded — out of scope here, note only.
acceptance_criteria: packs/watch/descriptor.json exists and validates against the pack-descriptor schema (validatePackDescriptor): id `watch`, version `0.2.0`, and a skill resource for `watch` whose origin (github.com/bradautomates/claude-video) and pin (83da59fa78c3eee9e20f515fe75c438bb5166efd) match the integrations.lock.json `skill:watch` edge
src/builtin-packs.js registers the watch descriptor+module pair (appended to BUILTIN_PACK_DESCRIPTORS and BUILTIN_PACK_MODULES) alongside design-power, at the documented single accretion point

After `node bin/pack-ctl.js reconcile-apply --repo-root <root>`, the owned copy at assimilated-skills/watch/ is materialized into .claude/skills/watch/ (SKILL.md + scripts/ present) with its provenance block intact
dist/pack-ctl.cjs (and any other affected dist bundles) are rebuilt via npm run build:plugin and committed; tests/e2e/dist-parity.spec.js passes
No assimilate security invariant is weakened and no existing pack/reconcile/assimilate spec regresses; npm run test:all is green
The reconcile no-op case for design-power is unchanged (design-power still reconciles as before; watch is additive)

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
RESCOPED (2026-07-23) after tracing the reconcile path. Original scope (author descriptor + register built-in pack) is INSUFFICIENT: `reconcile-apply` materializes only resources the desired-set resolver keeps, and `src/pack-resources.js#resolveDesired` keeps a resource iff `src/design-profile.js#resourceActivations(profile)[resource.id] === true`. `resourceActivations` is a hardcoded closed-world map of design-power resource ids only (frontend-design, ui-ux-pro-max, shadcn-vue, shadcn/ui, gsap, firecrawl, openart, playwright). A `watch` resource id is `undefined !== true` → excluded → never planned → never materialized. So the reconcile pipeline has NO generic (non-design) activation seam; that is the real gap.

Verified facts for the fix:
- A pack is "active" purely on validatePackDescriptor + satisfiesCoreCompat (src/pack-registry.js#resolveActivePacks) — no trigger/profile gating at pack level. A valid watch descriptor with core_compat ">=1.0.0" WILL be processed by reconcile-apply.
- descriptor schema (state/pack-descriptor.schema.json) treats `activate_when` as any non-empty string (no enum) — an "always" sentinel is schema-legal, no schema change needed.
- pack module is optional: loadActivePacks does `moduleRegistry[id] || {}`, so watch needs no module entry.
- applyPlan materializes from sourceRoot default <repoRoot>/assimilated-skills → .claude/skills/<id>/ and re-hashes against the lock integrity (already sha256:74b70be... for skill:watch).

Chosen design (minimal, principled seam): in resolveDesired keep a resource when `resource.activate_when === 'always'` OR `resourceActivations(profile)[resource.id] === true`. This decouples unconditional resources from the design profile WITHOUT touching design-profile.js. design-power resources use freeform activate_when strings ("always (design_heavy)", "tier != LIGERO", ...) that never equal exactly "always", so zero regression to the existing design-power flow.

ADDED acceptance criterion: src/pack-resources.js#resolveDesired activates a resource whose activate_when is exactly "always" regardless of the profile, while every design-power resource's activation is byte-for-byte unchanged (regression-locked). Human directive: full architectural fix first (no manual materialize), then reconcile-apply, then live-test the skill.

comments.author: uat
comments.body:
Live-test of the `watch` skill (human directive "then we should test the skill"; human selected the video https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7FU98O0JLHs and delegated execution — steps verified by Orchestrator at the human's request). Runtime deps ffmpeg + yt-dlp installed via winget on this Windows machine (Python 3.7.2; all 7 skill scripts byte-compile under 3.7).

Steps (expected → observed → verdict):
1. Skill materialized + discoverable → `.claude/skills/watch/` present and surfaced as available skill "watch (assimilated for Hivemind)" → PASS
2. setup.py preflight runs + accurately reports env → before install: status needs_install_and_key, missing [ffmpeg,ffprobe,yt-dlp]; after install: status needs_key, missing [] → PASS
3. yt-dlp caption pull + video download → download/video.mp4 + en.vtt + en-orig.vtt + info.json produced; transcript source = native captions (no Whisper key needed, --no-whisper) → PASS
4. ffmpeg scene-aware frame extraction honoring --max-frames 12 → exactly 12 JPEG frames (frame_0001..frame_0191) over the full 1379s video → PASS
5. Claude Reads frames as images + aligns with transcript → read frames render correctly (frame_0001: a "NeuraFlux" serif landing page; frame_0104: a browser component/pagination gallery, presenter webcam corner); transcript is a Claude-Code web-design tutorial (fonts, hero imagery, motion, "cultivating taste", Chase AI Plus) — frames + transcript coherently answerable → PASS
6. reconcile idempotency + design-power unaffected → confirmed at review (second reconcile-apply no-op; design-power installed:[] unchanged) → PASS

Overall: PASS. The assimilated skill functions end-to-end (download → captions → frames → Claude vision) on this machine. Note (not a defect): ffmpeg/yt-dlp are a documented user prerequisite on Windows — the skill's own setup.py prints install commands rather than auto-installing (macOS/brew only).

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
DONE. Registered `watch` as a built-in pack and added a generic non-design activation seam so the assimilated skill materializes via reconcile-apply. Single commit 194d709 (tests-after): generic seam in src/pack-resources.js#resolveDesired (keep resource when activate_when==='always' OR resourceActivations(profile)[id]===true — decouples unconditional resources from the design-profile closed-world map, exact-string sentinel, zero design-power regression), packs/watch/descriptor.json (valid; origin/pin match the skill:watch lock edge), src/builtin-packs.js registration at the accretion point, rebuilt dist/pack-ctl.cjs + dist/init.cjs, regression locks in tests/pack-resources.spec.js + builtin-packs.spec.js + e2e/pack-ctl.spec.js, and the materialized .claude/skills/watch/.

Review: APPROVE at review_depth=FULL (rubric inputs: multiple core surfaces — pack-resources.js desired-set resolver + builtin-packs.js registration + rebuilt dist/ bundles — AND a security-adjacent surface, integrations.lock.json + assimilated-skills/watch materialization). 0 HIGH / 0 MEDIUM code / 2 LOW (live-test-gates-close reminder [now satisfied]; commit bundles the vetted assimilation artifacts with the seam — defensible as AC3's deliverable). Reviewer independently reproduced the developer's greens exactly: test:since HEAD~1 = 86 passed (non-vacuous), fast tier = 999 passed/2 skipped, test:all = 1833 passed/4 skipped (dist-parity + use-cases green), named e2e 89 passed; regression lock proven non-vacuous (reverting the seam yields [] vs required ['watch']); live + owned copies hash to the lock's content_integrity sha256:74b70be8. The reviewer's process MEDIUM (couldn't see the dev hand-off checklist) is resolved by the Orchestrator: the hand-off carried the full 5-item pre-hand-off checklist with per-item outcomes.

UAT: PASS (see uat comment) — end-to-end /watch on a real video (download → native captions → 12 ffmpeg scene-aware frames → Claude vision) after installing ffmpeg+yt-dlp via winget; human delegated execution.

No HIGH finding and no REQUEST-CHANGES loop → no knowledge draft per TASK-105. Follow-up noted (out of scope): consider auto-discovering built-in packs from packs/*/descriptor.json instead of the hardcoded BUILTIN_PACK_DESCRIPTORS list.
